attempts.summary: Configured logrotate on node1 (Alpine) to rotate /var/log/inventory/app.log daily, keep 7 compressed rotations, and let the app keep writing after rotation via copytruncate. Installed logrotate, wrote /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app, wired it into the existing crond daily periodic job (and started/enabled crond, which was previously stopped and not in the default runlevel), and verified functionally before and after a full node restart.
